prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Tobias Reyne after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Multilingual documentation site
client: Gridbeam Robotics
client_industry: robotics
start: 2025-05
end: 2025-06
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Next.js
- MDX
- Algolia
implied_skills:
- internationalization
built: A docs site in 4 languages with instant search, written in MDX by the engineers.
metrics:
- 4 languages at launch
- support tickets down 27%

The review is from: Gridbeam Robotics
Rating: 5.0 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- Focus mostly on how they handled feedback; do not just repeat the project summary.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "internationalization".
text: Tobias was easy to work with and took feedback well throughout the project. We had a few rounds of changes on the docs site, and he handled them quickly without making it a bigger process than it needed to be. The final result launched in 4 languages and the instant search worked well for our team. We’ve also seen support tickets down 27%, which has helped a lot.
